svg.text: Drawn in the convention of Harris & Harris, Digital Design and Computer Architecture: RISC-V Edition, Figure 7.61. Black = datapath, blue = control. Signal suffix = stage (F D E M W).

svg.text: Additions to the textbook processor: a branch predictor in Fetch (BTB + 2-bit bimodal counters) picks PCF'; every instruction carries PredNext; Execute compares the real next PC with it;

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a misprediction, trap, mret or FENCE.I redirects from Memory, flushing D, E and M. CSRs are read in Memory, so ResultW has a fourth source. Load-use and CSR-use stalls come from the Hazard Unit.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Simplified for clarity: the 4-entry fetch buffer is drawn as the IF/ID register, and the data cache's early address, the WB→ID bypass, the address adder and predictor training are not shown (see pipeline.svg).
